records.text: mu'asay mukusa di binayu pai siw?

senses.en: How do you go to the mountian?
What will you go there for?

records.text: namisiw ina ka, "haapet mu'asay pai siw?"

senses.zh: 她的母親問，“妳要做什麼？”
讓我們看看為什麼那是這樣
senses.en: Let's see why that is so.

senses.zh: 他告訴她的丈夫如此這般，那個青年好
senses.en: She told her husband so and so and that the young man was a good guy.
